title: TroyApps — Handy Mobile Tools
description: TroyApps: handy mobile tools by an independent developer from Türkiye. Morse Flash and AirMouseHand are on Google Play.

morse-flash.lead: Flashlight & SOS, LED text, Morse send-read, alert flash and rhythm flash — in one app.
feats: LED text — turn the screen into an LED sign
Alert flash — light on calls & alerts
caps: Turn your screen into an LED sign
Alert flash — catch every call, even on silent
Message with light: Morse send & read
Flash to the beat: rhythm flash + strobe
Flashlight & SOS — always ready, even offline

airmousehand.lead: Hands-free browsing on Reels, Shorts and TikTok with hand and face gestures.
caps: Hands covered in flour? Pinch in the air
Assign any command to any finger
Both hands busy? Use your mouth
Hands full? Just open your mouth
